title: Lakehouse: backup restore round-trip (warehouse-restore-verify)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore lakehouse warehouse --yes`. Mirrors the node-local backup back into a fresh `warehouse-restore-verify` bucket and counts the restored objects — the integrity round-trip proof.

observe.what: GREEN backup restore warehouse — items restored = the same N objects taken

whatProves: LakehouseAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync mirrors the node-local backup into a verify bucket and counts the objects (the take/restore round-trip).
